projectionSource: candidate-examples-v4.json /examples/*/claimContent; v3 definitions remain inherited, W05 uses the explicit v4 C04 extension.

presenceRules.claimState: Exactly PENDING_REVIEW; a contract constant, not caller-selected truth.
presenceRules.operation: claimPosture, performedBy, allegesSoftwareAgentPerformance and temporalBasis required only for ASSERT_OPERATION_CLAIM. Agent and performer-authority arrays obey the exact existing PERFORMED conditional presence rules.
presenceRules.compliance: ruleRevisionBindings and evidencePolicyRevisionBindings required only for ASSERT_COMPLIANCE.
presenceRules.scopeProof: subjectScopeProofBindings required when exact subject/anchor identity and revision do not establish the relationship; remain separately verified typed proof inputs.
presenceRules.association: Association is never a member of P. Outside P, ABSENT means no intent associatedSemanticEventBinding; PRESENT carries exact owner verification inputs. No association presence, envelope, ingress reference, compatibility case, time selector, family, proof or association outcome is serialized into claimText or added to assertionBody. Claim domain time and operation meaning remain complete in P.
presenceRules.extensions: Any new body member or binding role needs a closed selector and branch rule in the versioned package before use. Unknown members are rejected, never silently dropped. Existing complete body fields such as context/payload bindings are included whenever the selected body permits them.

excludedExactRoles.reason: Trusted runtime injection for online; independently resolved/admitted act evidence for offline. Not caller-authored claim content.
Authorization chooses the accountable asserting Party. Caller mirrors cannot supply it; there is no intent assertedByPartyRef field.
Submission-act posture stays in complete governed input validation, outside the reporter's domain proposition for both postures.
Required offline, absent online. Excluded from P and the rendered ordinary evidence list to avoid self-attestation recursion; remains covered by the whole effectIntentDigest.
Exclude only this rendered output itself from its input projection.

excludedExactRoles.wireLocation: intent /associatedSemanticEventBinding plus separately supplied verification inputs and protected-effect trace; no AssertionRecord destination
excludedExactRoles.reason: PR23 section 1 item 8, section 7.3 and AR_EVENT_ASSOCIATION require trace-only association. Case IDs and time selectors select verification predicates, not additional claim content.

exclusionSemantics: Exclusions are exact owned roles/paths, never a recursive field-name or string filter. Do not remove an alleged performer, a historical reporting act, measured time, qualifier or other domain value merely because it uses a similar label. No self-act record or descendant depending on the final body may be laundered into ordinary evidence to recreate the cycle.

authorship.online: The submitting author or their authoring client renders the complete claim before authenticated submission. The runtime verifies that text, leaves the body unchanged and supplies top-level assertedAt before intent validation/hash. Independently selected authorization Party is compared to result assertedByPartyRef; it is not inserted into claimText.
authorship.offline: The author fixes the same claim projection and rendered body first. The separate act-evidence owner records exactly that submitted subject, scope, body and evidence content, source timestamp and Party/basis. Finalize and hash that record, bind it at assertionActEvidenceBinding, then finalize/hash the complete intent. No effectIntentDigest or later evidence digest appears in the earlier act record.
authorship.humanApproval: The existing fresh-approval process approves the exact final complete intent where applicable; no runtime body-authoring permission or new approval rule is introduced.

preservation: 24 examples are byte-identical to v3. W05 retains every prior scalar value and qualification, adds exact source provenance and ordinary evidence binding, and is exactly re-rendered under v4. No association metadata is reintroduced.
next: Integrate this explicit projection into Phase A and the later new body-schema binding; do not mutate pinned v0.2 schema bytes.

eventMeaningDecision.W04: The pruning completion case restates O08 performanceFacet COMPLETED, exact activityInstance/work specification/finish conditions, target/extent and subjectTime already in P. It adds no domain allegation.
eventMeaningDecision.W22: The O22 in-progress compatibility case restates performanceFacet IN_PROGRESS and actual pending analytical output, target/context and subjectTime already in P. It adds no domain allegation.
eventMeaningDecision.futureDomainMeaning: A new domain allegation about an event requires an independently versioned domain atom and ordinary supporting-evidence role; it may not smuggle this submission association or its verification data into P.

eventTiming.beforeIntentHash: Fix exact body, expected package and either no association or immutable resolvable envelope binding/bytes.
eventTiming.beforeDomainPass: Separate owner proof must be complete, eligible and exact for envelope digest, authoritative family and fixed commit class.
eventTiming.validationPhaseProof: Permitted dependency order if independently completed before the verdict consumes it. No existing producer is claimed.
eventTiming.openOwnerInterface: Actual proof artifact/schema, producer, admission/reuse/context and availability milestone. A late CommitIngressResult is not automatically the earlier classification proof.

associationAliasRule: No association envelope, ingress proof or dependent validation trace may be laundered into ordinary assertion evidence under another logical name; use owner-resolved immutable byte identity and dependency closure. This excludes association verification roles, not independently defined ordinary domain evidence about an event.
